dataset: NASA C-MAPSS FD001 (turbofan run-to-failure, 100 train / 100 test engines)
model: XGBoost regressor (max_depth=5, n_estimators=300), piecewise-linear RUL cap 125
note: RMSE and the NASA asymmetric score are computed on the last observed cycle of each held-out test engine against the provided true RUL. This is a real RUL benchmark; the live fleet shows an estimated time-to-failure projected from each device's risk trend.
